items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Did Kenton ask you to write for him? Yeah. I still have a huge score... the last thing I'd written for him

ctx.x: Kenton, I think, was to the same extent. Kenton is not a great piano player, by any stretch, but an important writer of that era, but the point is they succeeded, both of them--
I didn't think that Kenton was a good writer.
He was a characteristic writer; he wrote the Kenton style and it stuck and it guided people. Is it fair to say it guided people? It established--
